services.name: Jersey Shore Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Our Sunset cruise is a fun and relaxing time on the water. Feel free to get into the Pirate Spirit and come dressed up, or just enjoy an evening on the water with friends and family. The Sea Gypsy II is the best and most unique way to tour the Barnaget Bay and Metedeconk River. We leave from our dock and return 1.5 hours later. We Travel down the Metedeconk and sail past Brick, Point Pleasant, around Herring Island through Bay Head Mantaloking, and back up the Metedeconk to return to port. While on the back side of Herring Island on the Intercoastal Waterway enjoy a calm relaxing No Wake Zone while viewing the Osprey Nests and beautiful homes along the water. services.name: Birthday Parties/Private Charters
services.desc: Forget the ordinary - give your child a birthday they’ll talk about for years. Jersey Shore Pirates in Brick, NJ is the #1 pirate-themed birthday party experience on the Jersey Shore, and it’s unlike anything else in New Jersey. Your crew boards the Sea Gypsy II for a swashbuckling 75-minute adventure on the Metedeconk River - a fully immersive, action-packed celebration where kids fire water cannons, battle the enemy pirate, decode a secret message in a bottle, and hoist real sunken treasure from the deep.
